subject: gk
question: Chaitya Hall of Maharashtra is an example of _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cave architecture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cave Architecture**

 
 
• Cave architecture involves creating structures within natural caves, often featuring rock-cut designs reflecting cultural and religious significance. 
 
• These caves serve as places of habitation, meditation, or worship. 
 
• **Prominent examples include the Ajanta Caves, Ellora Caves, and the Karla Caves in India.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• I**slamic Architecture**

 
 
• Islamic architecture is characterized by the use of arches, domes, and intricate geometric patterns. 
 
• Key features include the minaret (tall tower for the call to prayer), the mosque (place of worship), and the madrasa (religious school).
 
• **The Taj Mahal in India is a renowned example of Islamic architecture. **
 
 
 
• **Nagara Architecture**
 
 
• Nagara is one of the major styles of Hindu temple architecture. 
 
• It is characterized by a curvilinear tower (shikhara) that rises above the sanctum sanctorum. 
 
• **The Khajuraho temples in India are famous examples of Nagara architecture. **
 
 
 
• **Dravidian Architecture**
 
 
• Dravidian architecture is another major style of Hindu temple architecture, prevalent in South India. 
 
• It is characterized by tall, pyramidal towers (gopurams) that dominate the entrance to the temple complex. 
 
• **The Meenakshi Amman Temple in Madurai, India, is a prominent example of Dravidian architecture. **
